attributes.rationale: Archivum fills the gap between manual wikis (which require constant bookkeeping and rot) and LLM retrieval tools (which treat every query as a clean slate and accumulate nothing). An AI agent incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki so knowledge compounds with every source added and every question asked. Latin root 'archive' chosen for global recognisability, distinctiveness in PKM/dev tools space, and scalability from personal tool to product brand.

attributes.flow: file lands in /raw → parser extracts text + metadata → LLM processes into wiki pages → Qdrant + Neo4j updated
attributes.processing: sequential (not parallel) to avoid LLM rate limits
attributes.rationale: Sequential processing avoids LLM rate limits. /raw is write-once — files are never modified after ingest, protecting source integrity.

attributes.role: Incrementally builds and maintains wiki pages; writes markdown, embeds for semantic search, syncs relationships to graph DB
attributes.north_star_metric: agent-authored wiki pages — count of pages whose last write was by the agent, not the user

attributes.rationale: Both stdio and SSE transports are required so that desktop-local clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Zed) and web/remote clients (ChatGPT plugins, Gemini, remote agents) can all use the same server definition without per-client configuration. Official Python MCP SDK supports both from a single definition.

attributes.layout: three-panel: file sidebar / editor+active view / backlinks+context panel

attributes.rationale: Chosen to replace Obsidian, eliminating dependency on a closed-source local app and its sync paywall while providing equivalent markdown editing in-browser.

attributes.role: vector store for semantic search; derived index, fully rebuildable from markdown
graph database storing entity relationships; derived, fully rebuildable from markdown
attributes.risk: may be too heavy for home server — fallback is Kuzu (embedded graph DB)

attributes.role: embedded graph DB, fallback for Neo4j if RAM footprint too high on home server
attributes.rationale: Much lighter than Neo4j; no separate container required.

attributes.network: wiki-net bridge network (archivum-net in security section)
attributes.storage: named Docker volumes — survives restarts and upgrades
attributes.multi_tenancy_prep: wiki_id field on all data models from day 1
attributes.rationale: Single docker compose up with zero manual steps beyond .env is the deployment goal. wiki_id on all models from day 1 ensures future multi-tenancy without a rewrite.
Markdown files are canonical; Qdrant and Neo4j are derived and fully rebuildable from them. This makes the system resilient — indexes can always be regenerated from the source-of-truth files.

attributes.update_latency: within 5 seconds of new ingest completing
attributes.risk: first item cut if timeline is tight

attributes.approach: Qdrant semantic + Neo4j multi-hop + LLM synthesis + streaming SSE
attributes.save_answer: Save as page button creates new wiki page indexed in Qdrant and Neo4j

attributes.fallback: keyword search if vector results are sparse

LAN direct (full access on home network)
attributes.session_tokens: Short-lived JWTs (15 min) + refresh tokens (7 day), httpOnly SameSite=Strict cookies
attributes.tls: Caddy reverse proxy with auto TLS
attributes.db_isolation: Qdrant and Neo4j ports not exposed to host by default
attributes.rationale: No public port exposed directly. Tailscale for trusted access, Cloudflare Tunnel for share links only. /raw volume mounted read-only to all services except ingest pipeline to prevent source overwrite by bugs or compromised services.

attributes.storage: share_links table in SQLite (swappable to Postgres)
attributes.renderer: lightweight read-only renderer — no access to editor, search, graph, or write endpoints

features: autocomplete dropdown of existing page titles
broken link colour + create page tooltip

attributes.guest_limit: up to 3 users free on personal plan
attributes.rationale: Eliminates need for port forwarding or public exposure while giving trusted users full access from anywhere.

attributes.rationale: Scoped to one read-only subdomain (share.archivum.madebypranav.dev) so public sharing is possible without exposing the wiki editor, search, or write endpoints.
